description: Import logins and cards from a Bitwarden export (.json). Works with a plain export or Bitwarden's password-protected export.
passwordDescription: This file is password-protected. Enter the password you set when exporting from Bitwarden — not your Bitwarden master password.
reviewDescription: Review each item before importing. Items that look like an existing entry (same site + username) can be skipped, overwritten, or imported as a new entry.
noItemsFound: No Login or Card items were found in this file.
importedMessage: Import done. The new entries are pending — publish them from the vault screen when you're ready.
deleteFileReminder: For safety, delete the export file from disk now that it's imported — it's a plain-text copy of your passwords.
